title: Northgate Optical Eyewear Job Pricing Standard
content:
## 1. Charging rule

A Northgate Optical eyewear job is charged component by component on the order date:

1. the **base lenses** at the lens design's base lens price;
2. the **frame** at its tagged price;
3. a **material upgrade**, when the lens material is not standard plastic, at the lens design's upgrade price for that material;
4. **anti-reflective coating** at the design's anti-reflective price, unless the design includes it;
5. the **light-adaptive** or **blue-light filtering** option at its price, when ordered.

Scratch coating and UV protection are included where the design's schedule says so. Each component is posted as its own charge on the order date.

## 2. Plus discount on the charges

When the Plus discount applies to the job (no vision plan billed, and the membership on the job at a Plus tier on the order date), the components the design's Plus discount covers — the base lenses and the material upgrade — are charged after the design's Plus lens discount percentage, rounded to the cent **per component**. The amount of each posted charge is the amount after any Plus discount. Where the Plus discount does not apply, the base lenses are charged at the base lens price.

## 3. Conditions of ordering

- A lens material is ordered only when it is one of the materials the lens design is made in. This is judged from the system record of the job — its lens design and its lens material — before the order is placed.
- Lenses are fitted only into frames sold by Northgate, because no design allows lenses in a frame the member brings in.

## 4. Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

**Example A — Plus discount applies.** A Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses job (base lens price 99.99, polycarbonate upgrade 30.00, anti-reflective coating 35.00, Plus lens discount 15 percent), frame tagged at 120.00, no vision plan, Club Plus membership on the order date:

| Component | Price | Discounted? | Charge posted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base lenses | 99.99 | yes: 99.99 multiplied by 85 percent is 84.9915, rounded to 84.99 | 84.99 |
| Material upgrade (polycarbonate) | 30.00 | yes: 30.00 multiplied by 85 percent | 25.50 |
| Anti-reflective coating | 35.00 | no | 35.00 |
| Frame | 120.00 | no | 120.00 |

The job's charges total 265.49.

**Example B — same job billed to a vision plan.** The Plus discount is not applied, so the base lenses are charged at 99.99 and the material upgrade at 30.00; the frame and coating are charged as in Example A.

**Example C — material not offered.** A Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses job cannot be ordered in 1.60 high index, because the design is not made in that material.
